description: Header file defining the radio_uhd_device class and related functions for UHD radio device management, including device creation, configuration, and sensor access.

classes.name: radio_uhd_device
classes.description: Class managing UHD radio device operations, including creation, configuration, and sensor management.

methods.name: radio_uhd_device
methods.description: Constructor initializing the device logger.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the USRP device is initialized.

methods.name: usrp_make
methods.description: Creates and configures the USRP device based on device address.

methods.name: is_connection_valid
methods.description: Validates the connection, e.g., USB version for B2xx devices.

methods.name: get_type
methods.description: Returns the device type.

methods.name: get_mboard_sensor_names
methods.description: Retrieves mboard sensor names.

methods.name: get_rx_sensor_names

methods.name: get_sensor
methods.description: Gets a specified sensor value (double).

methods.description: Gets a specified sensor value (bool).

methods.description: Gets a specified RX sensor value (bool).

methods.description: Sets device time to unknown PPS.

methods.name: get_selected_tx_antenna

methods.name: get_time_now

methods.name: set_rx_gain
